mapper.select:
SELECT m.BATCH_SEQ batchSeq, m.REGIST_ORG registOrg, t3.ps ps, t4.termType AS termType, m.FEE_TYPE AS feeType, m.TRADE_TYPE AS tradeType, m.CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, m.CHARGE_BASIS chargeBasis, m.EFF_DATE effDate, m.FEE_MAXI feeMaxi, m.FEE_MINI feeMini, case when m.CHARGE_TYPE = '01' then m.feeRate * 100 else m.feeRate end as feeRate FROM ( select
T1.FEE_TYPE , T1.REGIST_ORG , T1.TRADE_TYPE ,
T1.CHARGE_TYPE , T1.CHARGE_BASIS , T1.EFF_DATE , T1.BATCH_SEQ , case when T1.CHARGE_TYPE = #{CHARGE_KIND_02,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then T2.CHARGE_VALUE else T2.CHARGE_RATE end as feeRate, T2.FEE_MAXI , T2.FEE_MINI from TRD_FEE_CONFIG T1,TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL T2 WHERE T1.SEQ_NO = T2.CONFIG_SEQ_NO AND T1.TRADE_MARKET=#{TRADE_PLACE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T1.BATCH_SEQ, T1.FEE_TYPE , T1.REGIST_ORG , T1.TRADE_TYPE , T1.CHARGE_TYPE , T1.CHARGE_BASIS , T1.EFF_DATE , T1.BATCH_SEQ , T2.CHARGE_VALUE, T2.CHARGE_RATE , T2.FEE_MAXI , T2.FEE_MINI ) m, ( SELECT BATCH_SEQ, TRADE_MARKET, FEE_TYPE, TRADE_TYPE, CHARGE_TYPE,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( ps, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (ps)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') ps FROM TRD_FEE_CONFIG WHERE TRADE_MARKET=#{TRADE_PLACE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ, TRADE_MARKET , FEE_TYPE, TRADE_TYPE, CHARGE_TYPE ) t3, ( SELECT BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( TERM_TYPE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (TERM_TYPE)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') termType FROM TRD_FEE_CONFIG WHERE TRADE_MARKET=#{TRADE_PLACE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ, TRADE_MARKET , FEE_TYPE, TRADE_TYPE, CHARGE_TYPE ) t4
m.BATCH_SEQ=t3.BATCH_SEQ and m.BATCH_SEQ=t4.BATCH_SEQ
and m.FEE_TYPE = #{feeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and m.REGIST_ORG = #{registOrg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by m.BATCH_SEQ,m.EFF_DATE desc

SELECT m.BATCH_SEQ batchSeq, m.REGIST_ORG registOrg, t3.ps ps, t4.termType AS termType, m.FEE_TYPE AS feeType, m.TRADE_TYPE AS tradeType, m.CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, m.CHARGE_BASIS chargeBasis, m.EFF_DATE effDate, m.FEE_MAXI feeMaxi, m.FEE_MINI feeMini, m.CHARGE_VALUE, m.CHARGE_RATE * 100 as CHARGE_RATE, m.IS_MLTI isMlti FROM ( select
T1.FEE_TYPE , T1.REGIST_ORG , T1.TRADE_TYPE , T1.EFF_DATE, T1.CHARGE_TYPE , T1.CHARGE_BASIS , T1.BATCH_SEQ , T2.CHARGE_VALUE, T2.CHARGE_RATE, T2.FEE_MAXI , T2.FEE_MINI, T2.IS_MLTI from TRD_FEE_CONFIG T1 inner join TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL T2 on T1.SEQ_NO = T2.CONFIG_SEQ_NO WHERE T1.TRADE_MARKET=#{TRADE_PLACE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T1.BATCH_SEQ, T1.EFF_DATE, T1.FEE_TYPE , T1.REGIST_ORG , T1.TRADE_TYPE , T1.CHARGE_TYPE , T1.CHARGE_BASIS , T1.BATCH_SEQ , T2.CHARGE_VALUE, T2.CHARGE_RATE , T2.FEE_MAXI , T2.CHARGE_VALUE, T2.CHARGE_RATE, T2.FEE_MINI, T2.IS_MLTI ) m
INNER JOIN ( SELECT BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( ps, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (ps)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') ps FROM TRD_FEE_CONFIG WHERE TRADE_MARKET=#{TRADE_PLACE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ, TRADE_MARKET , FEE_TYPE, TRADE_TYPE, CHARGE_TYPE ) t3 ON m.BATCH_SEQ=t3.BATCH_SEQ INNER JOIN ( SELECT BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( TERM_TYPE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (TERM_TYPE)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') termType FROM TRD_FEE_CONFIG WHERE TRADE_MARKET=#{TRADE_PLACE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ, TRADE_MARKET , FEE_TYPE, TRADE_TYPE, CHARGE_TYPE ) t4 ON m.BATCH_SEQ=t4.BATCH_SEQ
m.BATCH_SEQ = #{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select T1.SEQ_NO seqNo, T2.SEQ_NO detailSeqNo from TRD_FEE_CONFIG T1,TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL T2
T1.SEQ_NO = T2.CONFIG_SEQ_NO and T1.BATCH_SEQ = #{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select TRADE_TYPE tradeType, PS ps, BATCH_SEQ batchSeq, REGIST_ORG registOrg, TERM_TYPE AS termType, FEE_TYPE AS feeType from TRD_FEE_CONFIG WHERE TRADE_MARKET=#{TRADE_PLACE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
